confidence_notes: Meal, coffee and beer anchors come from search-result summaries of Numbeo's crowd-sourced Newcastle (Australia) figures (page dated Dec 2025) and other aggregators. These are aggregates, not verified menus, and I did not open pages directly. Beer was adjusted from a 0.5 L draught to a roughly 425 ml NSW schooner at restaurant pricing, and the meal figures were trimmed slightly. The searches found no Newcastle-specific cocktail or wine-by-the-glass prices, so those two are estimated from Sydney benchmarks and typical ratios to beer (cocktail about 1.8x, wine glass about 1.2x). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, with no accommodation searches and no live listings inspected. Hostel anchors are the least certain because Newcastle has few registered hostels, and July is winter off-peak apart from school holidays. The FX rate is the latest RBA observation reported by search (18 Nov 2026); I could not confirm whether a 19 Nov rate had been published.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced relative to Sydney (dining broadly similar to or modestly below, accommodation clearly cheaper) and to regional NSW coastal cities such as Wollongong. Numbeo-derived Newcastle aggregates were used for the core food and drink items.
